title: upOS — 8-module field-service operations product (designed solo, live in production; coded the landing page)
role: Sole designer of an 8-module operations product, and designer + front-end developer of the landing page
attribution: Spaceapps held the client relationship and Juan delivered as staff. He designed the whole product solo — 8 desktop modules, the deliberately scoped mobile subset, and the landing page — and coded the landing page ONLY. The product was built in Bubble by another developer; Spaceapps later hired a Next.js developer who rebuilt the app on a different stack and KEPT Juan's design. Discovery was run by Thiago, the tech lead, and handed to Juan as a finished board, so the product definition is not his. Team of three: Juan (design + LP build), Thiago (tech lead, discovery), one Bubble developer. The Figma file sits on the same starter file as Celus — DesignBoost's template, made production-grade by Juan and then adopted across the agency.
impact: The product is live in production with real users and is independently checkable — app.upos.com.br/login answers HTTP 200 with the Portuguese login form, re-verified 2026-08-22. This is the only client engagement in the portfolio where a stranger can confirm 'I designed a product and it shipped' in ten seconds rather than taking Juan's word. It is also the strongest single sentence available about any design here: Spaceapps later rebuilt the app from scratch on a different stack and kept the design intact — teams rewrite code and quietly redraw the UI all the time, so a design that survives a full platform migration is a design that worked. No metrics exist — confirmed absent across this whole corpus, not merely uncollected.
